messages:
sara: Heads-up — nightly eval for `longform-summaries` spiked, quality dropped ~12% on ROUGE-L and we're seeing a lot of repeated subtoken runs in generated outputs. examples in the eval dashboards: https://dash.redwood/tests/longform-summaries :eyes:

devon: same. saw big jump around 03:18 UTC when the attn-kernel-merge PR landed. streaks like `the the the` and repeated punctuation `... ...` but at subtoken boundaries, not word-level.

kevin: repro locally with seed fixed, small snippet that shows the loop:
```
python -c "from runtime.client import infer; print(infer(model='rwd-7b', prompt='Summarize long text', seed=1234, max_tokens=120))"
# result: '... the the the ...' reproducible only with the merged-attn kernel enabled
```

anita: hmm interesting — could be kv-cache ordering or an index off-by-one in the merged attention window. can we dump KV shapes + first/last attention logits from nightly job? ops-bot: kv-dump artifact uploaded: s3://artifacts/nightly/1942001234/kvdump.tar.gz

sara: added examples to the eval ticket: https://issues.redwood/ML-4821. tagging @kevin @devon for triage. :triage_tone:

kevin: quick diff I ran shows a codepath change in attention masking where we collapsed two passes into one and fused subtoken offsets. suspect the offset normalization fails when sequence length % block_size != 0. patch snippet:
```diff
- for i in range(0, L, block): compute_offsets(i)
- second_pass(...)
+ fused_pass(0, L)
```

devon: can reproduce on cpu sim too (slower) when input length = 1023 (one less than 1024). looks like boundary condition. I've run the nightly eval again with a small assert added in fused_pass and the regressions disappear.

anita: can we get a canary rollback to confirm? if rollback fixes nightly, we revert the merge and add unit tests for lengths around block boundaries.

deploy-bot: rollback of PR #4234 initiated on canary cluster at 04:02 UTC by dev-ops.

ops-bot: canary metrics: generation token-repetition rate down from 7.2% -> 1.1% after rollback (5 minute window).

sara: great — please keep canary running another 2 hours and then schedule a patch that preserves fusion but fixes offsets. Kevin, can you own the fix + tests?

kevin: on it. I'll add targeted unit tests for seq lengths: 1023, 1024, 1025 and stress run nightly quantized variants. also will log per-head attention sums to catch any silent normalization issues.

devon: also flagging to eng-ml: quantization nightlies might exacerbate this — want to run QAT-sim on the same inputs. @anita please coordinate.

anita: will schedule QAT sim run and add probes into the eval harness to capture subtoken-level n-gram overlap metrics (self-BLEU-ish) so we can alert earlier.

sara: thanks team. next steps: (1) kevin patch + unit tests, (2) extend nightly evals with subtoken repetition detector, (3) roll forward once canary stable. filing follow-ups in ML-4821.

kevin: initial PR ready, pushing tests now. small note: we'll need a debug toggle `ATTN_FUSE_STRICT_BOUNDARY_CHECK` to validate in prod canary without perf hit.

devon: agreed. let's avoid long perf regressions while we iterate. :thumbsup:

sara: closing loop later with a postmortem in #postmortems. thanks all.
